info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Closes-v4-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Closure Reporting API provides businesses with the capability to retrieve a list of closed support tickets. This endpoint allows users to access valuable insights into ticket resolution outcomes, enhancing operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. Typical consumers include support managers and team leads who need to analyze closure trends and identify areas for improvement. By utilizing this API, organizations can effectively monitor their support performance and ensure timely resolutions.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to close an existing ticket in the system. Once closed, the ticket will no longer be active and cannot be reopened. Ensure the correct ticket ID is provided in the request.

requestBody.description: Request body for closing a ticket. Ensure that all necessary information is included before making the request.

202.description: Request accepted for processing and will be completed shortly.

ListSupportTicketsClosesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for closing a ticket operation which is expected to be a string.

ListSupportTicketsClosesResponse_202.title: Close Ticket Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the reference of the operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the ticket after the close operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Informational message related to the operation.

ListSupportTicketsClosesResponse_202.description: Response schema for the operation of closing a ticket, containing the status of the operation along with additional details.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the ticket.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the ticket operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Detailed information regarding the auditing of the ticket operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. This value is useful for performance monitoring and optimization.
